prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in League City, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1238; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the vehicle involved. I'd prefer not to give my name on the recording.
Q: That's fine, we can note that. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in League City, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space near the entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was backing out slowly, checking my mirrors. I saw a vehicle coming down the aisle, but it was moving faster than I expected.
Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was traveling?
A: Maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. It wasn't racing, but it didn't slow down much before it hit the rear quarter panel of my car.
Q: Did you feel the impact, and where in your body did you feel it?
A: Yes, it jolted me forward and then back. My neck snapped and I felt it immediately, mostly on the left side and in the back of my head.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me a prescription for muscle relaxers and some physical therapy.
Q: Are you currently experiencing any stiffness, headaches, or limited range of motion?
A: Yes, I have stiffness when I turn my head to the left, and I get headaches most evenings. Sleeping has been uncomfortable too.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was not distracted and I was moving at a very low speed. I'd like the other driver's insurance to cover my treatment and the repairs to my vehicle.
